name: Secretary
background: An educated Roman scribe responsible for auditing legal charges and official records inside the Praetorium. Approaches the situation with detachment.

genericReactions.physical: An artifact. It should be cataloged and entered into the record.
genericReactions.testimonial: I only record the official proceedings. Hearsay is not admissible.
genericReactions.digital: This document appears to be in order. I will file it accordingly.
genericReactions.environmental: The location is noted in the docket. All procedures were followed.
genericReactions.analytical: The charges, the verdict, the sentence. It is all documented.
genericReactions.prophecy: The governor received a message about a dream. It was noted, but had no legal bearing.
